details:
Q1: Which part of the coding-workflows repository should this issue improve?
Choices:
A. The issue → PR pipeline phases: clarify, plan, implement (`ai-clarify.yml` and the plan/implement workflows)
B. Review and autofix (`.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` and its `scripts/review_autofix_step_*.sh` helpers)
C. The orchestrator: `orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, waves and tracking issues
D. The AI memory subsystem (`scripts/ai_memory.py`, `scripts/memory_helpers.sh`)
E. Documentation and onboarding (README.md, `docs/how-it-works.md`, Quickstart)
F. Something else, or a specific workflow, script or file (please name it in your `/answer`) (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What kind of "better" do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a specific bug or failure you have seen; please link the run, PR or log (RECOMMENDED)
B. Cut cost or runtime (fewer tokens, fewer GitHub API calls, faster runs)
C. Make it more reliable: fewer stalls, retries or manual interventions
D. Add a new feature or behaviour (please describe it)
E. Improve the docs or make the logs clearer
Q3: How will we know the issue is done?
Choices:
A. A concrete, testable outcome that you state in your `/answer`, for example "run X no longer fails with Y" or "Z completes in under N minutes" (RECOMMENDED)
B. One small, surgical improvement in the chosen area, protected by a contract test
C. A broader overhaul of the chosen area, which will need an orchestrator tracking issue split into multiple PRs
**Note:** C only fits when Q1 names one area. A whole-repo overhaul is out of scope for a single issue.
